name: ROG Control
description: Everything asusctl does for ASUS ROG laptops, in DankMaterialShell: keyboard Aura RGB with LED colour correction, Slash ledbar, platform profiles, CPU/GPU power limits, a fan-curve editor, charge limit, GPU MUX/Eco and firmware toggles, with a live illustration of your laptop. Talks to asusd over D-Bus.
